words.definition: n. 边境，边疆；（知识）前沿

examples.en: The two countries agreed to open their frontier for trade.
examples.zh: 两国同意开放边境进行贸易。

examples.en: Genetic engineering stands at the frontier of modern science.
examples.zh: 基因工程处于现代科学的前沿。

words.usage: 本义边境、边疆；引申义「前沿」高频：the frontier of science。close the frontier 关闭边境。比 border 多开拓、探索意味。
collocations: the frontier of science 科学前沿
close the frontier 关闭边境
words.mnemonic: front（前面）+ier → 国土最前端 → 边境、前沿

words.definition: vt. 羞辱；使丢脸

examples.en: He was humiliated in front of his colleagues.
examples.zh: 他在同事面前蒙受了羞辱。

examples.en: The team suffered a humiliating defeat at home.
examples.zh: 这支球队在主场遭遇了惨败。

words.usage: vt. 常用被动：be humiliated in front of others。派生：humiliation n. 羞辱；humility n. 谦逊（褒义），二者勿混。
collocations: be humiliated in public 当众受辱
a humiliating defeat 蒙羞的惨败
words.mnemonic: hum（拉丁语「地」）→ 把人踩到地上 → 羞辱

words.definition: n. 边缘；刘海；流苏；adj. 次要的

examples.en: The organization remained on the fringe of political life for decades.
examples.zh: 该组织几十年来一直处于政治生活的边缘。

examples.en: Fringe benefits such as health insurance attract many applicants.
examples.zh: 医疗保险等附加福利吸引了许多求职者。

words.usage: on the fringe of 处于…边缘；the fringe of a forest 森林边缘。英式指刘海，美式说 bangs。术语 fringe benefits 附加福利。

confusables.note: n. 冰箱，差 n 字母

collocations: on the fringe of… 处于…的边缘
words.mnemonic: f+ridge（山脊）→ 沿山脊边缘 → 边缘、刘海

words.definition: vt. 传播，散布；繁殖

examples.en: Extremists use the internet to propagate their ideas.
examples.zh: 极端分子利用互联网传播其主张。

examples.en: These rare plants propagate very slowly in the wild.
examples.zh: 这些珍稀植物在野外繁殖得非常缓慢。

words.usage: propagate ideas／rumors 传播观点／谣言；plants propagate by seeds 靠种子繁殖。派生：propagation n. 传播。
collocations: propagate by seeds 靠种子繁殖
words.mnemonic: pro（向前）+pag（钉）→ 钉好向前传 → 传播

words.definition: vt. 发…的音；宣布，宣称

examples.en: The judge pronounced the sentence in a solemn voice.
examples.zh: 法官以庄严的声音宣布了判决。

examples.en: Many learners struggle to pronounce the th sound correctly.
examples.zh: 许多学习者难以正确发出 th 这个音。

words.usage: pronounce a sentence 宣判；pronounce sb dead 宣布死亡。派生：pronunciation n. 发音（拼写特殊）；pronounced adj. 显著的。
collocations: pronounce sb dead 宣布死亡
pronounce words clearly 吐字清晰
words.mnemonic: pro（向前）+nounce（说）→ 说出口 → 发音；宣布

words.definition: adv. 在头顶上方；n. 经常费用；adj. 头顶上的

examples.en: A flock of wild geese flew overhead in perfect formation.
examples.zh: 一群大雁以整齐的队形从头顶飞过。

examples.en: The firm reduced its overheads by allowing remote work.
examples.zh: 该公司通过允许远程办公削减了经常开支。

words.usage: adv. 在头顶上方：a plane flew overhead。adj. overhead wires 高架线。名词复数 overheads 指经常开支，商业阅读高频。
words.mnemonic: over（在上）+head（头）→ 头顶上方

words.definition: n. 卫生；保健学

examples.en: Good hand hygiene is essential in preventing infection.
examples.zh: 良好的手部卫生对预防感染至关重要。

examples.en: The restaurant was fined for breaching food hygiene regulations.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅因违反食品卫生规定被罚款。

words.usage: 不可数名词。固定搭配 personal hygiene 个人卫生、food hygiene 食品卫生。派生：hygienic adj. 卫生的（注意 -ic 结尾）。
words.mnemonic: 谐音「还净」→ 还讲究干净 → 卫生

words.definition: n. 霜；霜冻；vt. 结霜于

examples.en: A heavy frost covered the fields before sunrise.
examples.zh: 日出前浓霜覆盖了田野。

examples.en: Late spring frost destroyed most of the apple blossoms.
examples.zh: 晚春的霜冻毁掉了大部分苹果花。

words.usage: 不可数名词。hard frost 严重霜冻；late frost 晚霜；frost on the windows 窗霜。派生：frosty adj. 结霜的、冷淡的。

synonyms.note: 泛指冰；frost 指凝华的霜

collocations: be covered with frost 覆满霜
words.mnemonic: 与 freeze 同源：冻出来的白花 → 霜

words.definition: vt. 埋葬；掩埋；专心于

examples.en: The villagers buried the supplies in the ground to hide them.
examples.zh: 村民把物资埋进地下藏了起来。

examples.en: Deep in the library, he was buried in his research.
examples.zh: 在图书馆深处，他埋头于研究之中。

words.usage: 比喻用法 be buried in books 埋头读书为考研常考；bury one's face in one's hands 掩面。派生：burial n. 埋葬。
collocations: be buried in books 埋头读书
bury the hatchet 言归于好
bury one's face in one's hands 掩面
words.mnemonic: 谐音「搬入」→ 搬入土中 → 埋葬；掩埋

words.definition: n. 摘录；提取物；vt. 提取，榨出

examples.en: The machines extract oil from the seeds at low temperatures.
examples.zh: 这些机器低温从种子里提取油脂。

examples.en: The author quoted a long extract from the original report.
examples.zh: 作者引用了原报告中的一段长摘录。

words.usage: 重音转移词：名词 ˈekstrækt，动词 ɪkˈstrækt。extract A from B 从 B 中提取；名词义「摘录」。派生：extraction n. 提取。
collocations: extract oil from… 从…提炼油
extracts from the speech 演讲摘录
words.mnemonic: ex（出）+tract（拉）→ 拉出来 → 提取；摘录

words.definition: n. 烟气，浓烟；vi. 发怒

examples.en: Workers were overcome by toxic fumes in the tunnel.
examples.zh: 工人们被隧道里的毒烟熏倒了。

examples.en: He stood outside the office, fuming over the unfair dismissal.
examples.zh: 他站在办公室外，为不公正的解雇愤愤不平。

words.usage: 常以复数 fumes 出现，指有害气体：exhaust fumes 尾气。vi. fume at sth 为…发怒。派生：fuming adj. 勃然大怒的。
collocations: fume at sth 为某事发怒
words.mnemonic: 谐音「愤」：烟呛人也冒火 → 烟气；发怒

words.definition: adj. 公开的；明显的

examples.en: The new policy met with overt resistance from the unions.
examples.zh: 新政策遭到工会的公开抵制。

examples.en: There was no overt sign of tension between the two leaders.
examples.zh: 两位领导人之间没有公开紧张的迹象。

words.usage: 只作定语或表语：overt discrimination 公开歧视。反义词 covert（隐蔽的）为阅读常考对。副词 overtly 公然地。
words.mnemonic: o+vert（转）→ 转到明面上 → 公开的

words.definition: n. 库存；清单；vt. 盘点

examples.en: The manager checked the inventory before placing new orders.
examples.zh: 经理在下新订单前核对了库存。

examples.en: The report gives a detailed inventory of the country's mineral resources.
examples.zh: 报告对该国矿产资源列出了详细清单。

words.usage: take inventory of… 盘点清查；inventory levels 库存水平。美式可作动词「盘点」。与 invent 同根不同义，勿混。
collocations: a detailed inventory 详细清单
words.mnemonic: in（进）+vent（来）→ 进来登记入册 → 库存清单

words.definition: adj. 歇斯底里的；狂乱的

examples.en: The fans grew hysterical as the concert reached its climax.
examples.zh: 演唱会达到高潮时，歌迷们变得狂热失控。

examples.en: She became hysterical when she could not find her child.
examples.zh: 找不到孩子时，她变得歇斯底里。

words.usage: 多含贬义，形容情绪失控、狂乱的；口语中也可形容「极可笑的」。派生：hysteria n. 歇斯底里；hysterically adv. 歇斯底里地。群体行为、心理学阅读常见，常与 panic 同现。
collocations: become hysterical 变得歇斯底里
hysterical screaming 歇斯底里的尖叫
words.mnemonic: 源自希腊语「子宫」→ 古人以为此病子宫作怪

words.definition: n. 女主人；情妇；女教师

examples.en: The dog waited faithfully at the gate for its mistress.
examples.zh: 狗忠实地守在门口等它的女主人。

examples.en: The politician resigned after the scandal about his mistress broke.
examples.zh: 情妇丑闻曝光后，这位政客辞职了。

words.usage: master 的阴性对应词。今多指「情妇」（keep a mistress），含贬义；旧指女主人、女教师，需依语境判断褒贬。
collocations: the mistress of the house 女主人
words.mnemonic: master（主人）的阴性版 → 女主人

words.definition: adj. 不新鲜的；陈腐的，过时的

examples.en: The bread had gone stale after only two days.
examples.zh: 面包才放了两天就变味了。

examples.en: The party cannot win with such stale campaign slogans.
examples.zh: 靠这些陈旧的竞选口号，该党无法获胜。

words.usage: 本义食物不新鲜，引申指观念陈腐、笑话老掉牙、空气污浊：stale ideas、stale air、stale jokes。系动词 go／turn stale 变得不新鲜。注意与 stall（货摊；拖延）拼写区分。
collocations: stale bread 不新鲜的面包
words.mnemonic: 谐音「死了」→ 面包「死」了 → 不新鲜

words.definition: n. 人群；vi. 聚集，拥挤；vt. 挤满

examples.en: An excited crowd gathered outside the courthouse.
examples.zh: 激动的人群聚集在法院外。

examples.en: Commuters crowded into the already packed subway car.
examples.zh: 通勤者涌进本已拥挤的地铁车厢。

words.usage: n. a crowd of onlookers 围观人群；v. crowd into 涌入；be crowded with 挤满。follow the crowd 随大流为写作高频。
collocations: a crowd of onlookers 一群围观者
crowd into the stadium 涌入体育场
words.mnemonic: crow（乌鸦）+d → 乌鸦成群 → 人群；拥挤

words.definition: adj. 内心的；向内的；adv. 向内

examples.en: Behind her smile lay an inward sadness.
examples.zh: 她的笑容背后藏着内心的忧伤。

examples.en: The corridor turns inward about halfway down.
examples.zh: 走廊走到一半便向内拐去。

words.usage: 形容词指「内心的」：inward peace 内心平静；副词指「向内」：fold the paper inward。反义词 outward。派生：inwardly adv. 内心深处。
collocations: an inward curve 向内弯曲
words.mnemonic: in（内）+ward（方向）→ 向内 → 内心的

words.definition: n. 湿度；湿气

examples.en: Relative humidity rises sharply after the summer rain.
examples.zh: 夏日雨后相对湿度急剧上升。

examples.en: The high humidity made the heat unbearable.
examples.zh: 高湿度让人难以忍受酷热。

words.usage: 不可数名词：relative humidity 相对湿度、humidity levels 湿度水平。派生：humid adj. 潮湿的；humidifier n. 加湿器。
words.mnemonic: humid（潮湿）+ity → 湿度

words.definition: vt./vi. 碰撞，颠簸；n. 肿块；碰撞

examples.en: In the darkness he bumped into a shelf and woke everyone.
examples.zh: 黑暗中他撞到了架子，把大家都吵醒了。

examples.en: The airline bumped up its fares during the holiday season.
examples.zh: 假期期间这家航空公司提高了票价。

words.usage: bump into sb 撞上／偶遇某人（口语高频）；bump up sth 抬高；名词 a bump on the head 肿块。speed bump 减速带。
collocations: bump into sb 偶遇某人
bump up prices 抬高价格
a bump on the head 头上的肿块
words.mnemonic: 拟声「砰」→ 撞出个包 → 碰撞；肿块
